name: Birthday Waterproof Eye Lash Adhesive Glue 4gm
description:
Description:
Secure your false eyelashes with ease using this waterproof eyelash glue. Designed for strong hold and long-lasting wear, it keeps lashes in place all day without lifting or smudging.

Key Features:

Waterproof Formula: Resistant to sweat, tears, and humidity.

Strong & Long-Lasting Hold: Keeps lashes securely in place.

Easy Application: Smooth tip for precise application.

Safe & Gentle: Suitable for sensitive eyes.

Quantity: 4g

Perfect for daily wear, special occasions, or festive looks, this eyelash adhesive ensures your lashes stay flawless and natural all day.
